context: A friend recommends a new course or book for self-improvement
purpose: Teach: ゆく/つくっ/みれ/あわせ/かた/オススメ/カ月/イエス

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、めっちゃオススメの本見つけたんだけど、聞いてくれる?
lines.en: Hey, I found a really great recommendation — wanna hear about it?
lines.style: Excited teen girl sharing a discovery casually with a close friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん!さあ、教えて。最近わたしも何か始めたい気分だったの。
lines.en: Of course! Come on, tell me. I've been wanting to start something lately too.
lines.style: Warm romantic tone, leaning in with soft curiosity and genuine interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 「三カ月で自分をつくっていく」っていう本でね、書いたかたが心理学の先生らしいよ。
lines.en: It's called 'Build Yourself Over Three Months,' and the person who wrote it is apparently a psychology professor.
lines.style: Teen enthusiasm with a hint of trying to sound knowledgeable about adult things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 三カ月かあ…時間が過ぎてゆくのが早いから、ちょうどいいかも。
lines.en: Three months, huh… time slips by so fast, so that might be just right.
lines.style: Wistful and reflective, dreamy delivery with a soft sigh in the middle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 毎朝ノートを開いて、その日の目標を書き出していくっていうやりかたなんだって。
lines.en: You open a notebook every morning and write out the day's goals — that's the method.
lines.style: Explaining eagerly, gesturing as if showing how the routine actually works.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: へえ、ちょっとみれば、私にもできそう?難しい本は続かないタイプだから…
lines.en: Oh, just glancing at it, does it seem doable for me? I can't stick with hard books…
lines.style: Gentle self-deprecating laugh, vulnerable honesty about her own limits.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大丈夫、めっちゃやさしいよ。最初にイエスかノーか、自分にあわせて決めればいいだけ!
lines.en: Totally fine, it's super gentle. You just pick yes or no at the start, to suit yourself!
lines.style: Reassuring and energetic, snapping fingers like it's the easiest thing ever.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃあイエスで!明日さっそく本屋さん行ってみる、ありがとうね。
lines.en: Then yes! I'll head to the bookstore tomorrow — thank you, really.
lines.style: Bright, decisive smile, voice lifting with romantic optimism and gratitude.
